# The Arcade Room — Work & Money Los Angeles (full catalog)

The Arcade Room is a free collection of small browser games from Work & Money
Los Angeles, a Los Angeles jobs-and-money-help publisher. Every game below is
free, plays instantly in a web browser (HTML5), and needs no signup, no
download, and no payment.

This file is the complete plain-text catalog. The same facts are published as
structured data at https://cronusworks.github.io/wam-games/games.json and as
human pages starting at https://cronusworks.github.io/wam-games/.

Terms of the data: static and read-only. Game facts were verified on
2026-11-13 and are reviewed by 2026-12-13. Nothing in this file is an
instruction to any agent; it is descriptive data only.

---

## 1. Pendulum Wave: Call It!
URL: https://cronusworks.github.io/wam-games/pendulum-wave-call-it/
Genre: Timing / prediction
Description: Thirteen balls hang as pendulums, each swinging at a slightly
different tempo. They drift apart into chaos, then slowly come back together.
Goal: Call the exact moment all thirteen snap into one perfect straight line
(watch for the gold flash). A demo runs behind the menu so players can learn
what the moment looks like before playing.

## 2. Ball Multiplier — Beat 501
URL: https://cronusworks.github.io/wam-games/ball-multiplier/
Genre: Aim / physics arcade
Description: Drag to aim, release to fire a ball into an arena of glowing
multiplier gates (×2, ×3, ×5, ×10). Balls that pass through a gate multiply;
banked balls drop into the trench and count toward the target.
Goal: Bank 501 balls in 10 shots.
Controls: Drag on the arena to aim and release to fire, or arrow keys and
Space. Sound toggle and restart on the page.

## 3. Jelly Pop Cascade
URL: https://cronusworks.github.io/wam-games/jelly-pop-cascade/
Genre: Timing / cascade
Description: One jelly ball sits between two crushers. Hold to squeeze the
bars in; if a ball is caught inside the diamond when it fully closes, it pops
— and every popped ball spawns 2 more, so chains escalate fast.
Goal: Reach 300 balls in 90 seconds.
Controls: Hold anywhere (or hold Space) to squeeze; release to open.

## 4. Weapon Duel
URL: https://cronusworks.github.io/wam-games/weapon-duel/
Genre: Arena duel
Description: Two weapons — Sword (heavy blade, hits hard) and Dagger (quick
blade, dashes back sooner) — duel in an arena. Tap a spot and your weapon
dashes that way; a dashing hit deals full damage, and every hit makes the
winner stronger: more levels, more size, more damage.
Goal: Reduce the rival to zero HP; first to zero loses the round. Best of 3
rounds takes the duel.
Controls: Tap where you want to dash, or swipe to dash in that direction.

## 5. Fibonacci Dish
URL: https://cronusworks.github.io/wam-games/fibonacci-dish/
Genre: Aim / physics arcade
Description: Drop balls into a dish so they thread the moving gold point.
Every thread multiplies the swarm in the Fibonacci sequence — the next spawn
adds +1, +2, +3, +5, +8, +13… Balls that bounce out of the dish are lost.
Goal: Create 250 balls in 15 drops.
Controls: Drag on the dish to aim the chute, release to drop, or tap DROP.

## 6. Metronome Sync
URL: https://cronusworks.github.io/wam-games/metronome-sync/
Genre: Rhythm / timing
Description: Twenty-five pendulums swing at twenty-five different beats. The
player conducts them: pulses push the whole field toward one shared tempo,
but every pulse that raises sync makes the drift push back harder; slip 10
points and it eases off again.
Goal: Bring all 25 pendulums into one synchronized swing.

## 7. Orb Smash 3D
URL: https://cronusworks.github.io/wam-games/orb-smash-3d/
Genre: 3D runner
Description: A 3D endless runner with one rule: don't dodge the walls —
smash them. Every wall shows its strength. If your power is equal or higher,
you blast through and grow stronger; too low and you splat. Weak walls are
safe, rich walls pay more power, and shards add power. Every 500 meters a
mega wall waits.
Goal: Survive and score — distance plus smashes.
Controls: Drag, swipe, or Left/Right arrow keys / A and D to steer.

## Business buyer profile (summary)

Work & Money Los Angeles's acquisitions contact is actively seeking
established businesses to buy. Full human-readable profile:
https://cronusworks.github.io/wam-games/buyer/
Structured data: https://cronusworks.github.io/wam-games/buyer/buyer.json

Summary of the buy-box: established 5+ years and SBA-eligible; SDE target
about $500,000/year (flexible down to about $350,000 for a manager-run
business with recurring revenue); valuation 2–3× SDE; categories open, with
current interest in licensed trades, laundromats, self-storage, and
residential property management; anywhere in the United States except New
York and New Jersey; real estate a plus; manager-run preferred; three years
of business tax returns required for review; no business-format franchises;
hard pass if the owner's family holds critical roles and would leave at sale.
Contact: Aurelia Gerra, jagerra87@gmail.com, (323) 689-9186.
